purpose: Minimal machine-readable routing index for repeated AI-assisted development. Canonical state is not duplicated here.

directories.src: canonical editable source and source evidence grouped by module
directories.source: legacy/historical material only; never an active canonical source_path
directories.runtime: machine-readable active runtime metadata and verified fast indexes
directories.artifacts: recovery, exact runtime binary cache, binary audits and deterministic reproducers
directories.artifacts/runtime_cache: content-addressed exact DLL bytes for fast current-runtime packaging
directories.archives: deprecated/intermediate archive experiments; do not scan by default
directories.tools: verification, restore, packaging and maintenance scripts

rules: AGENTS.md defines the AI operating contract
runtime/current.json decides the active stack and canonical source provenance
runtime/verified_symbols_5875.json is a derived fast index only; its listed provenance remains authoritative
when a task needs shared build-5875 native primitives, consult the verified-symbol registry before opening unrelated large module sources
never use an omitted/unresolved registry topic as verified evidence
active DLL binary_artifact entries provide the normal exact-byte packaging path
prefer targeted module reads over repository-wide search
work must be synchronized with current main before a new iteration
main contains only accepted stable state
stable baseline numbers are rollback points, not experiment counters
normal work candidates may temporarily have stale source_sha256/source_size promotion fingerprints; the fast verifier warns and candidate build metadata records the exact source used
run source_metadata_sync before stable promotion so deep verification sees exact source fingerprints
when GitHub git-data tools are available, group one logical multi-file iteration into one commit to avoid duplicate CI runs
the AI owns routine GitHub housekeeping; the user should mainly describe behavior and test in game
never mix TBC/Wrath/Retail APIs or assumptions into build 5875 code
